Definition: darkly flashing (only of the eyes); in a good sense, brilliant (as stimulated by wine)
BiblicalUsage: Chakliyl is darkly flashing, red with wine — Jacob's blessing of Judah says his eyes will be red with wine, and his teeth white with milk.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe red eyes in Judah's blessing are abundance, not drunkenness: wine and milk are the promise of the land.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
